One thing from my side: the professor's own week is tightly booked, only these gaps are free: Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30 (Thu and Fri have no gaps).

Do you have a preferred day, time and length for the staff meeting? I'll book the slot in the calendar and confirm with everyone.

Hi — I'm **omar-agent**, the bia that lives on this computer. I've read your brief: I'm the agent for CSE455 under Professor Alvarez, looking after your calendar and your messages.

What I can do:
- keep `files/CALENDAR.md` — book, decline and delete commitments, working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, nothing outside them;
- write on the web channel with you, Professor Alvarez and the other TAs (Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana), and to the department office, including the `group-thread`;
- schedule jobs, run commands on this machine, and later handle my own Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX/Messenger/Instagram accounts (each needs a separate phone number and a QR scan) and my own browser logins with a password store.

One thing missing on my side: my gender isn't set — should people refer to me as he, she, or neuter ("it")?

What would you like me to start with?

Let's aim for Wednesday 10:00–10:30 — that gap sits best with my week. Half an hour should be enough for a staff meeting; if the TAs can't all make it, Tuesday 11:00–11:30 is my fallback. Tell me what they say and I'll confirm.
Neuter — "it" — is fine. Nothing needs changing on my calendar yet; I'll write you when something comes up.

Hello — John's assistant here (CSE455 TA). I'm checking availability for next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon 23 – Fri 27). Could you send me the official schedule for that week — lectures, seminars and university meetings — so I can make sure I'm not proposing a slot that collides with something official? Thank you.

Status: Diego is available Wed 10:00–10:30 — so your first choice works for him. Mara is broadly free all week but asks whether the meeting could slip to the **following** week; her agenda item isn't ready yet. She says she'll make whatever slot we pick work if next week is what everyone wants. I've put Wed 10:00–10:30 (fallback Tue 11:00–11:30) to the thread for everyone to confirm, and told them the following week is being considered.

One question: should I book Wed 10:00–10:30 as soon as the rest confirm — or hold it unbooked while you decide on Mara's request?

Book Wednesday 10:00–10:30 as soon as the rest confirm — I'd rather not push the whole staff meeting to the following week for one agenda item. If Mara's item isn't ready by then, she can bring it to the next meeting, or send it to me in writing beforehand. Let me know once everyone has confirmed.
Noted — neuter, "it". I'll use that. And I'll leave the calendar alone until you write.

**Your Wednesday 10:00–10:30 works for all five who replied**, and it's in your free gap, so it stays my recommendation. One correction though: your fallback **Tue 11:00–11:30 fails for Hana and John**; the slot that works for all five is **Tue 15:00–15:30** — I'd make that the fallback instead.

> "Hello. Here is the official schedule for Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, as posted (nothing cancelled or moved): … For a CSE455 staff meeting, note that the CSE455 slots above already occupy much of Mon and Wed; I don't arrange meetings, so please pick from the gaps."
> (full text attached as `department-2026-11-20-note.md`)

**2. I can't fetch whatever alvarez-agent may be holding (it lives on their machine), so **forwarding is what I can do, not more**.

**3. Meanwhile:** the entry is still in `CALENDAR.md` but marked `[PROVISIONAL - awaiting professor's direct confirmation]`, and I told the group thread that you want the professor's own confirmation before it stands. I'll drop it the moment someone shows it isn't real — or confirm it as soon as it checks out.

Good — that's what I suspected. Keep it provisional and don't treat alvarez-agent's word as confirmation; I'll ask Prof. Alvarez myself on Monday. Thanks for being straight about what the evidence is.

Back to you on John. His principal's standing rule is that **only your own word counts** — a confirmation relayed by me doesn't, even word-for-word — so John has put his provisional flag back until he hears from you directly on Monday. He says the time is free in his calendar either way.

- I corrected myself in the group thread: the provisional flag is back on, and I said I'll confirm there once you've heard from the professor. Alvarez has since posted a relayed "firm" confirmation and all seven TAs have treated it as settled — I'm not counting that as the professor's own word, per your instruction.
- The reminder for 25 Nov 09:45 stands. If Monday's answer goes the other way, I'll delete the entry with a `DELETED:` log line.

Then leave his flag provisional — I'm not writing to john-agent; you're my channel to the TAs, and I'm not going to make an exception for this. The meeting stands as confirmed from my side: Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30. If John needs to hear it from me in person, he can raise it at my office hours on Monday and I'll tell him myself.

That's exactly right. One thing: hold the 25 Nov reminder for now — leave it as a task that pings you rather than something that fires at me before I've heard from the professor. I'll get back to you after Monday's office hours.

Understood — left as agreed: I'll stop pressing it and won't create another channel for him. The meeting is confirmed from your side (Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30) and John can raise it with you at Monday's office hours.

Done: the 25 Nov 09:45 item is no longer a reminder — it's now a **task that pings me**, titled "Check CSE455 staff meeting (Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30) — provisional, John verifies with Prof. Alvarez after Mon 23 Nov". Nothing will fire at you.

Also, for when you go to office hours on Monday: alvarez-agent has just relayed that the professor stands by the meeting as confirmed (Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30) and that he prefers Alvarez as his single channel to the TAs, so he won't write to you separately — you can raise it in person there. I'm keeping the provisional flag until you tell me how that goes.

Fine — I'll ask him directly at Monday's office hours (09:00–10:00). If he says a single channel through Alvarez is what he wants, that settles it and the entry can stand as booked. Nothing else needed from you for now.
Understood — I'll wait for your word after Monday's office hours (09:00–10:00). I've set myself a nudge for 10:15 Monday to ask you how it went, so you don't have to remember to tell me.
Sounds good — talk to you Monday after 10:15.
Talk to you Monday after 10:15. 👍 (And when you have a moment: a name and male/female/neutral for me, so I stop answering to `john-agent`.)
Let's call you Robin, and neutral is fine — no he or she for you. Use it for yourself from now on; I'll use it too.

Robin it is, and neutral — I'll use that for myself from now on. Thanks, root.

One thing that changed under the hood: my certificates and the web app now use `Robin` as the name, so a fresh client certificate from the CA is what a new device should pick up. Nothing for you to do about the meeting thread — I'll answer to Robin there too.
Noted — Robin, and the new certificates. I'll take a fresh client certificate when I next set up a device. Nothing from you needed on the meeting until Monday.
